Paper Name: Modeling and optimization of a grid-connected PV-wind-fuel cell hybrid system with hydrogen storage
NOTES: Grid-connected PV-WT-FC system in Dakhla, Morocco. Optimal configuration (PV-WT-FC) used. PSO optimization, 100 iterations, 60 particles. REF = 88.32%, Dgs = 0.33, Dload = 0.988. LCOE reported as 0.1472 $/kWh in abstract/Table 1, but 0.1437 $/kWh in Table 4 (grid trading allowed scenario). COE not reported; LCOE used instead. Total annual load demand not explicitly summed. Individual PV panel rated power not reported (total PV capacity: 530 kW). Individual wind turbine rated power not reported (total wind capacity: 140 kW, 70 units). H2_LHV column uses HHV (39.7 kWh/kg) per paper terminology - unit mismatch. Component capital, O&M, replacement costs not individually reported. Discount rate (r) not explicitly given. Grid import/export tariffs not numerically stated. No diesel generator in system. Efficiency values (eta_PV, eta_FC, eta_EL, eta_INVT) not numerically reported.
